Title: Inconsistent Auth-Gated Route Behavior
Evidence: /admin redirects to /login (correct); /admin/dashboard returns 404 without redirect (incorrect). Confirmed by Phase 1 audit.
Reproduction Steps: Navigate to /admin/dashboard without auth — no redirect occurs, returns 404
Fix Recommendation: Ensure ALL protected routes redirect to /login when unauthenticated. Audit React Router guards for every route under /admin/*

Title: API Error Messages Leak Framework & Route Structure
Evidence: GET /api/auth/login returns: {"message":"Route GET:/api/auth/login not found","error":"Not Found","statusCode":404} — reveals exact route pattern and Fastify error schema
Reproduction Steps: Fetch any non-existent API route: fetch('/api/anything')
Fix Recommendation: Replace verbose Fastify error responses with generic {"error":"Not Found"} in production. Set Fastify's exposeHeadRoutes and custom error handler.

Title: Wrong HTTP Method Returns 404 Instead of 405
Evidence: GET /api/auth/login (which is a POST-only endpoint) returns 404 Not Found instead of 405 Method Not Allowed
Fix Recommendation: Fastify should return 405 with Allow: POST header for wrong-method requests. Enables method enumeration by attackers.

Title: Domain Mismatch — robots.txt vs Backend
Evidence: robots.txt references berozgar.in; backend API references rkgit.ezexam.in; frontend served from rgitrozgar.in. Three different domain identities.
Reproduction Steps: Check robots.txt at rgitrozgar.in/robots.txt; inspect network requests
Fix Recommendation: Standardize all domain references. Update robots.txt. Audit CORS allowed origins for rkgit.ezexam.in exposure.

Title: Auth Protocol Display on Login UI (Information Disclosure)
Evidence: Login page publicly displays: AUTH_PROTOCOL: HMAC_HMAC_SHA256 — reveals authentication mechanism to attackers
Fix Recommendation: Remove auth protocol display from public-facing UI. Security through obscurity is not sufficient but unnecessary disclosure aids attackers.

Title: Security Headers — Status Unverified (Assumed Missing)
Evidence: Web block extraction did not return security headers. Browser agent JS console execution blocked. Headers not confirmed present. Based on nginx default config, CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options are NOT set by default.
Reproduction Steps: curl -I https://rgitrozgar.in and inspect response headers
Fix Recommendation: Add to nginx config: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy

Title: Login Form Inputs Have No Accessibility/Test Attributes
Evidence: React inputs on /login have no id, name, or data-testid attributes. Confirmed by previous audit agent and browser agent observation.
Fix Recommendation: Add name="email", name="password", id attributes to inputs. Enables both accessibility (screen readers) and automated security testing.

Title: JWT Implementation Unverified — Algorithm Confusion Risk Unknown
Evidence: Login not achieved; JWT payload, algorithm (alg claim), expiry, and role claims could not be inspected. HMAC_SHA256 displayed on UI but actual JWT alg header unconfirmed.
Reproduction Steps: Achieve login, capture token from localStorage, decode with: JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1]))
Fix Recommendation: Verify: alg is HS256 or RS256 (not 'none'); exp is set (recommend ≤24h); role claim present; token stored in httpOnly cookie (not localStorage) to prevent XSS theft.

Title: Email Enumeration — Status Unverified
Evidence: Could not test: correct email + wrong password vs nonexistent email error message comparison blocked by login failure
Reproduction Steps: Attempt login with known email + wrong password; compare error to unknown email + wrong password
Fix Recommendation: Ensure both cases return identical error: "Invalid credentials". Never reveal whether email exists.

Title: XSS Input Validation — Untested
Evidence: Could not inject or "> into login fields due to automation failure
Reproduction Steps: Manually enter XSS payloads in email/password/search fields
Fix Recommendation: Ensure React renders all user input as text (not innerHTML). Validate server-side. Implement CSP header as defense-in-depth.

Title: SQL/NoSQL Injection — Untested
Evidence: Could not test ' OR '1'='1 or ; DROP TABLE users;-- in login fields
Reproduction Steps: Manually enter SQL injection payloads in login form
Fix Recommendation: Prisma ORM provides parameterized queries by default — verify no raw query() calls with user input. Test with SQLMap if manual testing confirms risk.

Title: Session Invalidation on Logout — Unverified
Evidence: Could not test whether JWT is cleared from localStorage on logout, or whether old tokens remain valid after logout
Reproduction Steps: Login → capture token → logout → check localStorage → replay token to /api/me
Fix Recommendation: Implement server-side token blacklist or short expiry + refresh token rotation. Clear localStorage on logout. Verify token rejected after logout.

Title: IDOR on Profile/Application IDs — Unverified
Evidence: Could not access /profile/[id] or /applications/[id] endpoints without auth
Reproduction Steps: Login as student → note profile URL → increment/decrement ID → check if other profiles accessible
Fix Recommendation: Implement ownership checks on all object-level endpoints. Never rely solely on auth — verify resource belongs to requesting user.

Title: Version String Exposed in UI
Evidence: Login page displays: v0.1.0 // Campus OS
Fix Recommendation: Remove version string from public UI. Reveals pre-production maturity to attackers.

Title: .env File Returns 403 (Not 404)
Evidence: /.env returns 403 Forbidden — confirms file exists but is blocked
Fix Recommendation: Change nginx config to return 404 for .env (403 confirms file presence; 404 is more secure). Current behavior is acceptable but 404 is preferred.
